newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Spotless Group sees satisfactory year.
newsitem.headline: Spotless Group sees satisfactory year.

text.p: Plastics and diversified services group Spotless Group Ltd said on Wednesday it expected satisfactory progress for revenue and profit growth in 1997.
The company earlier reported a net profit of A$18.05 million for the year to June 30, 1996, up from A$12.09 million a year earlier.

"Directors expect, in the absence of any significant change in the economic outlook in the areas in which the company operates, that the 1997 year will show satisfactory progress for both revenue and profit above 1996," Spotless Services said.
The company said it expected the development of new market sectors by subsidiary Spotless Services Ltd to sustain satisfactory revenue and profit growth for the 1997 year.
Spotless Services earlier announced a net profit of A$20.27 million for the year, up from A$18.82 million a year earlier.
"Plastics division trading in the USA, South East Asia and New Zealand is expected to generate revenue and profit growth for 1997," Spotless Group said.
However, the company said plastics division trading conditions in Australia remained difficult.
